title: Nutty Algerian Chickpeas Tagine
description: A tangy and fluffy Algerian dish featuring chickpeas and a blend of spices, with a nutty flavor and a hint of sriracha heat, served in a unique nigiri shape, this recipe is also macrobiotic friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, sriracha sauce, and chopped almonds to the saucepan, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the tagine, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use your hands to shape the tagine mixture into small nigiri shapes.
Serve the nutty Algerian chickpeas tagine hot, garnished with additional chopped almonds if desired.
